releaseNotes:
Update v1.2.8:

1. Office Suite: In-app Word (.docx, .doc) with print layout, reflow mode, rich ribbon, and in-page editing.
2. Spreadsheets: Virtualized Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .csv) with full formula engine (=SUM, =AVERAGE, =IF, etc.), fx formula bar, and live aggregation status bar.
3. Legacy Formats: Support for Word 97-2003 (.doc), HTML and OLE2/BIFF8 binary Excel (.xls), and CSV.
4. Performance & Stability: Instant spreadsheet loading, deterministic folder sorting, and PDF password race condition fix.
